summary: In stui, clicking or choosing a request answer that needs the person's words opens its text box at once, ready to type in, and the button says Write your words; opened alerts above a conversation have more room between their title, text and buttons and may take up to three fifths of the pane

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.
